rawFindings.title: create() and publish() now crash when slug/title are numbers
rawFindings.explanation: The added call to `slugize(data.slug || data.title, ...)` no longer coerces numeric titles/slugs to strings. When `data.title` is `12345` and `data.slug` is unset, `slugize` receives a number instead of a string and throws, so post creation fails before any file is written.
rawFindings.suggestion: Restore string coercion before slugifying, e.g. `slugize((data.slug || data.title).toString(), ...)`, and do the same for `publish()`.
rawFindings.failureAfterChange: Calling `post.create({ title: 12345 })` now throws instead of creating `_posts/12345.md`.

rawFindings.title: publish() no longer accepts numeric slugs
rawFindings.explanation: The changed `slugize(data.slug, ...)` passes a raw number through to `slugize`. If a draft is published with `slug: 12345`, slug generation fails, so the draft cannot be found/published even though this worked before.
rawFindings.suggestion: Convert the slug to a string before slugifying, e.g. `slugize(data.slug.toString(), ...)`.
rawFindings.failureAfterChange: Calling `post.publish({ slug: 12345 })` now throws instead of publishing the draft to `_posts/12345.md`.
